name: empty-result
select: SELECT id, title FROM changes WHERE 0

name: grouped-count
select: SELECT task, count(*) AS n FROM recertifications GROUP BY task ORDER BY task

name: join
select: SELECT c.title, t.task, t.title FROM changes c JOIN tasks t ON t.change = c.folder ORDER BY t.task

name: trailing-semicolon
select: SELECT id, title FROM changes ORDER BY id;

name: literal-values
select: SELECT NULL AS empty, 'a' || char(10) || 'b' AS lines, 1.5 AS real, 7 AS whole, x'0102' AS bytes

name: empty-blob
select: SELECT x'' AS empty_bytes, zeroblob(3) AS zeros

name: integers
select: SELECT 0 AS zero, -7 AS negative, 9007199254740991 AS largest, -9007199254740991 AS smallest

name: string-escapes
select: SELECT '"q" \ /' AS quotes, char(8) || char(9) || char(10) || char(12) || char(13) AS named, char(0) || char(1) || char(27) || char(31) AS control, char(8232) || char(8233) AS raw

name: non-ascii
select: SELECT 'é ü' AS latin, char(128512) AS emoji, char(55296) AS surrogate

name: duplicate-keys
select: SELECT 1 AS a, 2 AS b, 3 AS a, 4 AS "2", 5 AS "2"
